resources.string: Vala inkulumo, ukuthinta futhi uhlole ngokuthinta uze uqalise kabusha SandFly
Misa isikhashana noma qhuba futhi SandFly
Ngenkathi okuthi SandFly kumiswe isikhashana, akukhulumi noma kuphendule ukuthinta, futhi isikrini sisebenza sengathi asikho isifundi sesikrini esivuliwe.
Ukuze uqhube futhi, cindezela isaziso esithi SandFly kumiswe isikhashana, cindezela ivolumu yehle izikhathi ezi-3 ngokushesha, noma khiya futhi uvuse ifoni ukuze kubonakale isikrini sokukhiya.
Ukuze uqhube futhi, cindezela isaziso esithi SandFly kumiswe isikhashana, cindezela ukwehlisa ivolumu izikhathi ezi-3 ngokushesha, noma vala isikrini bese usivula futhi.
Ukuze uqhube futhi, thepha okuthi SandFly isaziso simiswe isikhashana noma cindezela ivolumu yehle izikhathi ezi-3 ngokushesha.
